div.head: V Atr 35.1
div.ab: Sit nomen Domini benedictum et rel.
(Der Name des Herrn sei gepriesen u. s. w. G2 D)
(Blessed be the name of the Lord, etc. G2 D)
Blessed be the name of the Lord.
div.note: Not in G (so K is empty). In G2 the so-called ‘Polity’ (Thorpe p. 422) follows; in D, three Old English chapters on the Decalogue and the cardinal vices and virtues, then I As.

note.seg: folgt in ders. Hand sog. Polity ed. Thorpe Ancient laws p. 422

folgen drei Angelsächsische Capitel über Dekalog, Cardinallaster und -Tugenden; dann I As.; s. o. p. 146.
there follow three Anglo-Saxon chapters on the Decalogue and on the cardinal vices and virtues; then I As.; see above p. 146.
In Homilien gewöhnlich, wohl archetyp; s. Gl Gesetz 8
Usual in homilies, probably in the archetype; see Gl Gesetz 8
This phrase, which is reminiscent of homilies, is not found in G.
